_comment: Spike fixture (Task 2, sprint/lighter_mcp_runtime_spike_plan.md). Stands in for real IntegrationObject rows pulled from a registered service -- no live DB access was available to source this from an actual account's data, so these two operations are modeled on GitHub's public REST API shape (well-known, stable, publicly documented) rather than copied from a verified registered service. Swap this file for a real export before Task 7's live end-to-end proof; the shape (operation_id, method, path, parameters[].in, request_body, responses) is what both search_docs and call() read, so a real export only needs to match this same shape, not this file's contents.

operations.name: List user repositories
operations.description: List public repositories for the specified GitHub user.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The handle for the GitHub user account.

operations.name: Get a repository
operations.description: Get a single repository by owner and repository name.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The account owner of the repository.
